newsitem.title: USA: Clinton wishes Coretta Scott King on 70th birthday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton wishes Coretta Scott King on 70th birthday.

text.p: President Clinton on Sunday telephoned Coretta Scott King, the widow of slain civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr., to congratulate her on her 70th birthday, White House spokesman Barry Toiv said.

"Hillary and I wish you a happy birthday. I wish I were there with you," Toiv quoted Clinton as telling King in a call that was broadcast over loudspeakers at a birthday celebration at an Atlanta hotel.

Clinton made the call from Philadelphia, where he and former Presidents George Bush, Jimmy Carter and Gerald Ford are attending the three-day "Presidents' Summit" to encourage Americans to volunteer to do community service.
